tujuan: Ujian K5: huruf tangan, prompt ditegaskan (semakan mata 3 pintu; QC 8 ciri belum dibuat)
prompt: Hand-lettered typographic quote poster, portrait orientation. Solid black background, white lettering only. The text reads exactly, four lines: "BRAVE" / "hearts" / "BEGIN" / "again." Chunky, thick, hand-drawn letters like a modern hand-lettering illustration drawn with a brush marker, clearly not a typed font: every letter has a slightly different size, tilt and height, the baseline bounces up and down, uppercase and lowercase letterforms are mixed, the same letter is drawn differently each time. All four lines have the same width and form one tight compact block; the letters of each line touch and interlock with the letters of the lines above and below like puzzle pieces, with descenders, long tails and stretched strokes filling every gap between lines. Rough chalk and worn screen-print texture with small speckles inside the white letters. Wide empty black margins around the block. No other text, no letters except the quoted words, no signature, no watermark, no frame, no border, no mockup, flat 2D artwork.
nota: Masa = jam dinding termasuk barisan. Qwen-Image-2512 tidak dijana: kuota ZeroGPU habis (240 s diminta, -7 s berbaki). Mod rujukan: awalan prompt "Use the reference image only as a style guide..." + IMG_5730 sebagai input.
